title: 第3章 测灵根第4章 仙缘
slug: 开局一枚玉佩凡女低调修仙
lines: 时间悄无声息地溜走了十几天。
苏月身上的摔伤恢复得异常快。
左腿的疼痛已不再钻心，虽然走路还有些瘸，关节也有些僵硬，但总归是能慢慢活动了。
手上的擦伤和伤口也结了痂，不再流血。
按说她这样的伤，在村里没有好药的情况下，怎么也得躺个把月才能勉强起身，可现在，她已经能下地缓慢行走了。
这一切都归功于藏在衣衫内侧的玉佩。
虽然她仍不明白玉佩如何做到的，但它持续散发出的那股纯净温和的力量，似乎在默默地滋养着她的身体。
让那些淤青散得更快，让疼痛减轻，让身体自己修复的速度远超寻常。
父亲的病却依然不见好转，甚至看起来更虚弱了。
家里的粮食眼看就要见底，药罐子里的药越来越少，越来越稀。
后娘虽然没再提上山的事，但眉间的愁绪却怎么也化不开。
那日她说的“我来想办法”
，苏月知道，在这样的困境下，她又能有什么办法呢？
她再次握紧了胸前那枚温润的玉佩。
这个家里，唯一能带来转机的只有它，也只有自己。
卖掉玉佩？不。
这个念头，已被她彻底掐灭。
这枚玉佩是她唯一的念想，是她感觉中能联通另一个世界的渺茫希望。
用这份希望，去换取只能解一时之困的凡俗金银，是下下之策。
苏月知道自己不能再等下去了，但她要找的不是舍弃希望的退路，而是创造希望的出路。
她必须去镇上一趟。
坐困愁城，永远等不来转机。
只有走出去才有机会。
带着寻找出路的打算，在一个还算暖和的上午，苏月告别了家人，只说去镇上散散心。
她沿着那条熟悉的土路，再次走向镇子。
玉佩的秘密要守护，父亲的病也要靠自己的双手，去找到医治的希望。
离镇子还有一段距离时，她就远远地听到一阵不同寻常的嘈杂声，像是赶集，又比赶集更热闹，更沸腾。
人群不像往常那样三三两两进出镇子，而是大股大股地朝着镇口一个方向涌去，伴随着兴奋激动的议论声。
“快点快点，仙人还在呢！”
“测灵根啊！
一步登天的好机会！”
content_en:
Time slipped away quietly for more than ten days.
Su Yue recovered extremely quickly from her fall injury.
The pain in my left leg is no longer excruciating. Although I still have a slight limp when walking and my joints are a little stiff, I can finally move slowly.
The scrapes and wounds on my hands have also scabbed over and are no longer bleeding.
Normally, with an injury like hers, she would have to lie down for months before she could get up without good medicine, but now, she can walk slowly.
All this is due to the jade pendant hidden inside the clothes.
Although she still didn't understand how the jade pendant did it, the pure and gentle power it continued to exude seemed to be silently nourishing her body.
Make those bruises go away faster, make the pain lessen, and let the body repair itself much faster than normal.
However, my father's illness still did not improve, and he even seemed to be getting weaker.
The food supply at home is about to run out, and the medicine in the medicine jar is getting less and less.
Although the stepmother didn't mention going up the mountain again, she couldn't get rid of the sadness between her brows.
That day she said, "I'll find a way."
, Su Yue knew, in such a predicament, what could she do?
She once again clenched the warm jade pendant on her chest.
In this family, the only one who can bring about change is him, and only himself.
Sell ​​the jade pendant? No.
This idea has been completely eliminated by her.
This jade pendant was her only thought, the slim hope she felt that she could connect to another world.
It is the next best thing to use this hope in exchange for mundane gold and silver that can only relieve temporary difficulties.
Su Yue knew she couldn't wait any longer, but what she was looking for was not a way out of giving up hope, but a way out to create hope.
She must go to town.
Sitting in a sleepy city, you can never wait for a turn of events.
Only by going out can you have a chance.
With the intention of finding a way out, Su Yue said goodbye to her family on a relatively warm morning, saying only that she would go to the town to relax.
She walked along the familiar dirt road towards the town again.
The secret of the jade pendant must be protected, and his father's illness must be cured by his own hands to find hope.
When she was still some distance away from the town, she heard an unusual noise in the distance, like going to a market, but more lively and exciting than going to a market.
The crowd did not enter and leave the town in twos and threes as usual, but poured in large groups towards the entrance of the town, accompanied by excited discussions.
"Hurry up, hurry up, the immortal is still here!"
"Test the spiritual roots!
A great opportunity to reach the sky in one step! "
title_en: Chapter 3 Spiritual Root Testing Chapter 4 Immortal Fate
